challenges.instruction: The yellow square with a question mark is part of this cube net. When the net folds up into a cube, which face of the cube does the yellow square become?
challenges.hint: Start at the front square and fold the squares around it one at a time.
challenges.narration: Fold the net in your mind to find where the yellow square goes.
